summary: Frontend re-test of GPS Phase 1 UI after the fix that registered the 'vehicles' sub-tab in Fleet.subTabs. All requested flows pass end-to-end: sub-tab renders in the correct order, Manage Vehicles view shows GPS button, modal opens, master checkbox toggles the advanced settings block, filled settings save via PUT /api/tenant/settings/gps, button label flips to 'GPS On' with emerald background, /bookings Live Map tab appears when GPS is enabled and disappears after disabling + reload.
critical_code_review_comments: TenantDashboard.js is now ~3500 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting Fleet / Reports / Team / Overview into dedicated sub-components.

Non-blocking React warning in console: 'Received true for a non-boolean attribute jsx' (likely a styled-jsx boolean prop passed to a non-styled tag). Not caused by this iteration but worth cleaning up.
test_credentials: Fresh tenant created for retest: slug=gps-retest-1785063906, master admin admin.gps-retest-1785063906@quickwing.com / admin123 (professional plan, 1 seed vehicle 'Test Car 1' TEST-001).
seed_data_creation: 1) Created tenant 'GPS Retest gps-retest-1785063906' via POST /api/platform/tenants (super admin). 2) Added Test Car 1 via POST /api/vehicles as master admin so the setup-wizard redirect is skipped.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright evidence collected: sub-tab order = [subtab-live-fleet, subtab-vehicles, subtab-car-calendars, subtab-all-cars]. GPS modal contract (gps-enabled-checkbox toggles gps-advanced-settings, gps-settings-save PUTs settings, gps-settings-btn label + emerald class reflect state). /{slug}/bookings reads gps.enabled once on mount – hard-reload required after toggle (documented behaviour). Note the tenant dashboard base URL is /{slug} (not /{slug}/dashboard).
rca of the issue: Original bug (iteration 29): Fleet.subTabs did not include a 'vehicles' entry, so the render branch `activeTab==='fleet' && activeSubTab==='vehicles'` (which hosts the GPS settings button) was never reachable via the UI. Fix in TenantDashboard.js lines 691-696 adds {id:'vehicles', label:'Manage Vehicles'} to Fleet.subTabs, exposing the pre-existing render block and data-testids. Verified reachable and functional in this iteration.
